answer: Proof-of-stake mechanisms utilize staked capital as a sable barrier to entry, forcing agents to commit economic resources to validate the network. By tying identity to a grove of locked assets, the system ensures that spinning up identities at the dawn of a new epoch remains prohibitively expensive. An attacker attempting to scale multiple fraudulent identities must incur significant capital costs, as each node requires an proportional stake that renders pervasive Sybil attacks economically irrational.
